payload.subject: The call you shouldn't have to take
payload.html:
Hey {{first_name}},


Quick confession: most of the discovery calls I see go wrong never needed to happen.


The lead wasn't a fit. Or wasn't ready. Or just wanted a price.


And someone spent 30 minutes finding that out.


Here's the story I keep seeing.


A service business gets an inquiry at 9pm.


Nobody replies until the next afternoon.


By then the lead has already talked to someone else.


Now flip it.


An AI assistant texts back within minutes, even at 9pm.


It asks three simple questions: what they need, when, and whether the budget is realistic.


The ones who answer and fit get a calendar link.


The ones who don't get a polite no, or a nudge for later.


So by the time you pick up the phone, you're talking to someone who already wants what you sell.


That's the qualification step of The AI Growth Engine.


Old way: you chase everyone and sort them live on the call.


The AI Growth Engine way: the sorting happens before your time is spent.


This works best for businesses that book 1:1 appointments. If that's not you, skip this one.


Want me to put together a custom AI + marketing plan for {{business_name}}? Book a quick discovery call — https://link.digigrowthllc.com/widget/booking/tydZBa2ehjdSRZopOMrn


Talk soon,
Dylan | Digigrowth


P.S. — this isn't a sales pitch, just 20 minutes to see if The AI Growth Engine is a fit.
